title: Playboy Magazine September 1989 Playmate Twins Keith Hernandez Interview
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible light edge wear, corner wear, surface marks or creases. Please review the photo for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, September 1989 issue. Cover price $4.00.

Features:
- Playmate Twins - cover and pictorial, with a bonus-sized gatefold
- Mets star Keith Hernandez on drugs, Darryl and the agony of the aging ballplayer
- Pro Football Forecast
- The Book of Sexual Questions
